name: qwen-code
description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
one_liner: A free, open-source AI coding assistant that lives in your terminal, similar to Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, powered by Qwen's open models.
buyer: No direct buyer for the tool itself — it's a developer tool competing with paid coding assistants; money is made around it, not from it.
business_use_cases: A dev tools agency builds custom skills or subagents on top of it for a client's internal engineering workflow.
An outsourcing shop standardizes on it instead of per-seat paid tools to cut tooling costs across a large dev team.
A course creator builds a paid 'AI coding agents' training course using it as a free, inspectable example tool.

money_ideas.idea: Sell custom integrations, skills, or support contracts for teams adopting it instead of a paid competitor

steal_this: Offer a 'migrate your dev team off paid Copilot-style tools to free open-source AI coding agents' consulting package for cost-cutting companies.
